Secret partnerships: Joker holder + J of trumps holder = 'kankei' team (revealed when played). Rotating trump sequence: â™£â†’â™¦â†’â™¥. Also called Damari-Kan ('Silent Kan').

Kan is a popular card game in Aomori prefecture in Japan, especially at Goshogawara and Tsugaru. Yonin-Kan is the four-player variant, also called Damari-Kan (silent kan) because the Joker holder and Jack-of-trumps holder form a secret partnership and do not announce themselves until those cards are played.
40 cards: remove 2-4 of all suits + 5â™ . Include Joker.
Dealer shuffles and deals ten cards to each player, one at a time (40-card pack, four players).
